title: Keep the setup wizard's terminal while it runs helper processes
when: The setup wizard probes login-shell PATH, checks or opens a browser, or installs packages
need: Helper processes started by the wizard read /dev/null and run in their own session with no controlling terminal, so an interactive login-shell probe cannot become the terminal's foreground job. Interactive sudo refuses with setup_wizard_sudo_refused while the wizard is open; setup's preparation step asks for the password before the wizard opens. A setup_terminal_ownership_lost message names the job-control signal, the foreground process group and its command, and the errno of a failed check.
disclosure: Only when a helper would need the terminal, or ownership is lost
surface: Setup TUI and the terminal onboarding guide
gap: Live released proof on the Linux Test Machine is pending: see the setup-helper-terminal-live-proof gap.
review: Before the change, a linux-lab strace of the public installer showed setup's fresh-login probe `bash -lic` issue TIOCSPGRP, then SIGTTOU stopped setup before the first wizard input; zsh -lic takes the foreground the same way on macOS. POSIX PTY regressions run the real probe for bash and zsh inside the wizard driver and assert ownership stays intact; the unfixed zsh probe failed with the enriched diagnostic naming the foreground job.
